name: Xinjiang Joinworld Co., Ltd.
summary: Xinjiang Joinworld Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research and development, production, and sale of aluminum products in China and internationally. The company offers aluminum, electronic aluminum foil, medium and high voltage electrode foil, corrosion foil, etched foil, chemical foil, formed foil, aluminum alloys, and other electronic components.
